findings.claim: The shell consumers parse the presentation profile with sed 's/^audience:[[:space:]]*//p' and compare the result to the literal casual without stripping a trailing carriage return; .gitattributes pins only *.sh/*.plist/*.template/*.bat, so settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md is checked out (and git-archived into the installer srctree) with CRLF on Windows, and a profile installed from that template yields audience 'casual\r' — sync_skills.sh then takes the developer branch (no skillOverrides off, overlay deleted), and smine-nightly/run.sh never defaults orchestrate on, never forces dev mode off, and passes 'language de\r' to consolidate.
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/sync/sync_skills.sh:253-263 (sed parse + [ "$profile_audience" = "casual" ]), routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:33-47 and cmd/bootstrap/run.sh:59-66 (same sed parse, == casual comparisons); none strips \r. git show HEAD:.gitattributes lists only '*.sh text eol=lf', '*.plist', '*.template', '*.bat' — *.md is unpinned, so Git for Windows' default core.autocrlf=true checkout (from-source install.ps1 path) and the CI windows-latest 'git archive HEAD' srctree (ci.yml installer job, which applies working-tree eol conversion) carry CRLF in presentation-profile.de.md. The Windows -install path copies that template verbatim per spec-3 correctness-24 (copy of the repo template; Go copy not re-read here — cross-chunk). Sequence: smine-setup.exe with 'Deutsch - nicht-technisch (German, casual)' -> profile file 'audience: casual\r\n' -> next sync_skills.sh run (skills.Sync on /profile save, orchestrate duty re-sync) -> developer branch, every skill stays visible, contrary to correctness-44; nightly run.sh -> orchestrate stays off for the casual install (correctness-56). Distinct from known install_windows.go ordering finding (profile installed after syncs): this one persists across every later sync.
findings.fix: Strip CR in every shell profile parse (sed -n 's/^audience:[[:space:]]*//p' ... | tr -d '\r' | head -1, same for language:/dev-mode:), or add '*.md text eol=lf' (at least settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.*.md) to .gitattributes.
